name.title: What's your crew called?

name.hint: 3–40 characters. You can't change the link later, but you can rename it.

kind.body: This helps the right people find it.
kind.city: People living in the same city or town.
kind.visa: People on the same visa path.
kind.language: People who speak the same language.
kind.culture: People who share a culture or home country.
kind.interest: A hobby, a job, a stage of life.

details.visaBody: The 3-digit subclass, like 500 or 482. People on that visa will see your crew suggested.
details.languageBody: People who speak it will see your crew suggested.
details.placeBody: Pick a city, or keep it Australia-wide.
details.gateHint: Optional. Leave it Australia-wide if anyone can join from anywhere.

about.title: Tell people what it's about
about.body: A short welcome helps people decide to board.
about.label: Description
about.hint: Up to 500 characters. You can edit this later.

examples.interest: For example: "Weekend rides around the city. All levels welcome."
